title: HandObservation
description: Per-frame, per-hand landmark observation (Phase 01 contract; produced by hands, Phase 03). Coordinates are converted to ROI-normalized at the hands module boundary (ADR-0005). docs/architecture/contracts.md section 3.2.

t_capture.description: t_capture of the FrameSample this observation derives from (Task 01.3 rule: every record carries it).

present.description: False when the detector produced no landmarks for this hand in this frame; then landmarks, landmark_visibility, bbox and handedness_score are null.

detector_id.description: Landmark model / configuration id (e.g. a Hand Landmarker task file name + hash).

landmarks.description: 21 keypoints in the MediaPipe ordering (README section 14), ROI-normalized.

landmark_visibility.description: Per-landmark visibility/presence score if the estimator provides one; null otherwise.

handedness_score.description: Estimator's confidence that hand_id is correct.

bbox.description: Hand bounding box [x, y, w, h], ROI-normalized.
